info.name: Get the failures of a build.

params.name: BuildFailuresQuery
params.description: The query parameters used to retrieve the failures of a build.

items.docs:
**<mark>Beta:</mark>** Returns the failures of a build, organized by build tool (Gradle, Maven, npm).
The response structure includes nested objects for each build tool containing their respective failures.

info.name: Get a list of failure groups.

params.name: query
params.description: The query parameters used to retrieve the list of failure groups.

items.docs: **<mark>Beta:</mark>** Returns the list of failure groups.
